name: Baptist
otherNightReminder: Wake up the Baptist and have them choose 2 other, living players. Put the Baptist back to sleep. Then decide if you will put a Potion on one of them chosen players, and what type. If you put an evil Potion on either player, put the Cannot Die reminder token on the Baptist.
ability: Each night*, choose 2 living players (not yourself); either player might receive a potion. If either received an evil potion you cannot die tonight.
flavor: It's never too soon to contemplate eternal damnation, sir!
